title: Design System: Time Atlas - Clear Timeline

body.fontFamily: Noto Sans Thai, Geist Sans, Tahoma, sans-serif

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Blue start action with white text.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button">เริ่มถอดเสียง</button>
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #3c66d3; color: #fff; font: 640 14px/1.3 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; }

components.name: Service Status
components.description: Text status paired with a colored dot.
components.html: STT service พร้อมใช้งาน
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: #536982; font: 13px/1.5 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-status span { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #26764f; }

components.name: Transcript Time Rail
components.description: A timestamp row with a visible active position.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; } .ds-rail { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-rail:before { width: 1px; content: ''; background: #3c66d3; } .ds-rail i { width: 9px; height: 9px; position: absolute; top: 19px; border: 1px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: #3c66d3; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #d6e4fa; } .ds-segment { width: 100%; min-height: 58px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #edf3ff; color: #172b49; text-align: left; } .ds-segment time { color: #3c66d3; font: 12px/1.7 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Time Atlas is a local-first workspace for selecting media, transcribing it, and returning to the words at the right moment. A light canvas, white surfaces, Thai-first typography, and one blue accent keep the next action easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Light blue-gray canvas and white panels.
Clear blue marks primary action and active playback position.
Thai-first sans typography with tabular mono timestamps.
The transcript rail connects each passage to recording time.

rules.name: The One Blue Accent Rule
rules.body: Use clear blue for primary actions and current playback; keep inactive coordinate marks muted.

rules.name: The Time-is-Tabular Rule
rules.body: Render timestamps in a mono stack with tabular figures.

rules.name: The State-is-Visible Rule
rules.body: Pair active color with a tinted row and leading edge; pair status color with readable text.

dos: Keep file selection before the player and transcript.
Let long Thai transcript lines wrap.
Pair status color with readable labels.
Preserve natural page scrolling on small screens.
donts: Don't use dark panels, amber highlights, or decorative wallpaper.
Don't imply uploaded media or transcripts are saved as browser history.
Don't communicate active state through color alone.
